title: Find out more
content: Come along and have a go! These activities are available throughout the event. No registration needed, and everyone is welcome. Our vibrant, interactive permanent exhibition celebrates molecular biology with a focus on the work, people, and technologies of the European Molecular Biology Laboratory (EMBL). A combination of images, animations, film, and interactive games will take you on an exciting journey through the inner workings of life at all scales. Get curious about the microscopic world. Explore structures that are far too small to see with the naked eye, from individual cells and plant structures to the details of individual hairs. Get hands-on with microscopes, games and models, and discover fascinating things that are normally hidden from view. Foldscope station Take a closer look at the microscopic world with Foldscopes, lightweight paper microscopes that make tiny structures and patterns visible. Microscope in Action Discover how fluorescence microscopy reveals the details that are normally invisible, from individual cells and the vascular bundles inside plant roots to the structure of individual hairs. Euro-BioImaging matching game Can you match the organism to its microscopic image? This fun matching game connects the visible world of organisms with their hidden microscopic details. LEGO® atomic force microscope Step into the world of atomic force microscopy through our LEGO®-built model, bringing the fascinating world of nanoscale (really, really small!) imaging to life. Explore the microscopic world through the eyes of young participants (8-12 years old) from Foldscope Photography Workshops led by EMBL and photographer Jochen Steinmetz with local partners Kulturfenster, Stadtteilbüro Boxberg, and Quartiersmanagement Bergheim. Explore EMBL’s past through a display of historic instruments, documents and photographs. Meet the archivists and discover more about their work and the role of the Archive. Take a moment to pause and recharge in this calm, sensory-friendly space. Step inside Merck’s Curiosity Cube™ mobile science lab and you’re not just a visitor, you’re a scientist! Roll up your sleeves and experience hands-on science through exciting experiments. You can read more about Merck’s Curiosity Cube™ here . Join us at the Curiosity Fair to explore the world of science through hands-on activities and games. Build, create, play, and experiment while discovering how scientists investigate life on Earth, from DNA and microbes to life in the oceans and beyond. Explore the world of science through: DNA building blocks Discover the “code of life” by building and decoding secret messages using colorful building blocks and learn how DNA stores information. Cell cookies Build your own edible cell with sweets, then discover the amazing structures hidden inside cells and how they work together to keep it alive. Quackers for proteins Roll up, roll up, let’s get quackers for proteins and hook some (rubber) ducks! Uncover how scientists organise and explore the vast amounts of information hidden in the living world around us. Phytoplankton key chains Make your own plankton keyring using clay and learn about the tiny creatures that live in our oceans. DNA bracelets Make your own DNA bracelet and discover how DNA’s four building blocks fit together to make the instructions for life. Explore the microbiome Pick your character and race to the finish in this fun board game, discovering how scientists turn samples into scientific discoveries along the way. Microbiome memory game Find matching pairs and discover how the microbes in our gut support our health. Anaerobic challenge Just like a real-life scientist, test how it feels to do quick-fire tasks in an oxygen-free chamber – and discover more about the bacteria that live in our bodies. Lab kitchen Enter the lab kitchen and discover how equipment used in a lab is not so different to everyday items used at home. DNA base matching Test your reactions in this fast-paced card game and discover how the four bases of DNA pair together to carry genetic information. Tattoo parlour Visit our tattoo parlour to get your very own science-inspired temporary tattoo, designed by researchers at EMBL. Run, Scientist, Run! Come play and experience coastal ecology research for yourself through a life-size game inspired by the Traversing European Coastlines (TREC) expedition. Cuddly crochet match-up game Meet our cuddly crocheted organisms and discover the amazing creatures and tools used to explore the living world. Discover sustainability at EMBL and explore how small actions can support science and the environment. Explore this photography exhibition to discover the people and places behind TREC, a Europe-wide expedition that travelled Europe’s coastlines to advance our understanding of coastal life. Drop by our information stand, located by reception in the ATC, to discover EMBL, Europe’s laboratory for the life sciences, and explore what happens across our six research site
